verdicts.reason: A is a clean left-to-right banner: the can sits on the left, the logo, headline and subcopy are stacked on a shared centre axis, and the CTA is on the right. Hierarchy is clear. Its only flaws are minor: the can is shifted slightly high and sits close to the left edge, and the CTA floats a little high relative to the text block. B has no consistent alignment: the tiny SOLSTICE logo is jammed into the top-left corner, the headline is centred while the subcopy and CTA start at different left edges (about x=45 and x=22), the copy cluster is crowded against the left side, and the can is pushed to the far right with a large dead gap between them.
